fullPassage: Diya pointed at the lake and shouted, "Come on, Ryanna!" Ryanna stood still. She was wearing her regular clothes — her bathing suit was still in her bag. Her chest felt tight, and her hands were trembling. She didn't want to jump in. Something about it filled her with dread, even if she couldn't explain it. The thought of stepping into cold water with all her clothes on made her stomach twist. She looked at the adults standing on the dock, hoping someone would say, "It's okay. You don't have to." But no one did. They just stood there, watching. Her heart beat faster. She felt like crying, but she didn't want anyone to see. Especially not Diya. Everyone was looking at her now, and it made her feel even worse. She wanted to run away, but she felt trapped, like the fear had frozen her.

questions.stem:
다음 (A), (B), (C)를 문맥에 맞게 배열한 것으로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

(A) But no one did. They just stood there, watching.
(B) Ryanna stood still. Her chest felt tight, and her hands were trembling.
(C) She looked at the adults standing on the dock, hoping someone would say it was okay.

det.korean: (B) 처음 상태 → (C) 도움 기대 → (A) 실망
det.analysis:
❌ ① A가 먼저면 역접 연결 불가
✅ ② (B)-(C)-(A): 공포 상태→기대→실망 흐름
❌ ③ C가 먼저면 B의 상태 묘사가 없음
❌ ④ B-A-C: A(실망) 후 C(기대)는 역순
det.tip: 공포 상태 묘사(B) → 기대(C, hoping) → 실망(A, But no one) 순서.

questions.stem:
다음 (A), (B), (C)를 문맥에 맞게 배열한 것으로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

(A) She wanted to run away, but she felt trapped, like the fear had frozen her.
(B) Her heart beat faster. She felt like crying, but she didn't want anyone to see.
(C) Everyone was looking at her now, and it made her feel even worse.

det.korean: (B) 심장 박동 빨라짐, 울 것 같음 → (C) 시선 집중으로 더 악화 → (A) 갇힌 느낌으로 결말
det.analysis:
❌ ① A가 먼저면 감정 고조 과정 없음
❌ ② C-A-B: 감정 결말(A) 후 고조(B) 역순
✅ ③ (B)-(C)-(A): 감정 고조→악화→절정(갇힌)
❌ ④ A-C-B: 결말이 먼저
det.tip: 심장 박동(B) → 시선으로 악화(C) → 갇힌 느낌 절정(A).

questions.stem:
다음 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳을 고르시오.

[주어진 문장] But no one did.

( ① ) Ryanna stood still. ( ② ) She was wearing her regular clothes. ( ③ ) She looked at the adults on the dock, hoping someone would say it was okay. ( ④ ) They just stood there, watching.

det.korean: But no one did = 기대(hoping) 직후 실망 표현. ④ 위치: hoping 뒤, They stood watching 앞.
det.analysis:
❌ ①: 역접 연결 대상 없음
❌ ②: 상태 묘사 중간 — hoping 전
❌ ③: hoping 이전
✅ ④: hoping 직후 → But no one did → They just stood
det.tip: 역접(But)은 기대 표현 바로 뒤. ③ 위치의 문장이 hoping이므로 ④가 맞음.

questions.stem:
다음 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳을 고르시오.

[주어진 문장] Especially not Diya.

( ① ) Her heart beat faster. ( ② ) She felt like crying, but she didn't want anyone to see. ( ③ ) Everyone was looking at her now. ( ④ ) She wanted to run away.

det.korean: Especially not Diya = '아무에게도 보이고 싶지 않다, 특히 Diya에게는' — didn't want anyone to see 직후 강조.
det.analysis:
❌ ①: beat faster 뒤에 '특히 Diya' 연결 어색
❌ ②: anyone to see 다음 문장이지만 ② 위치는 crying 표현 후
✅ ③: didn't want anyone to see 직후 강조어 삽입
❌ ④: run away 전 연결 어색
det.tip: 'Especially not Diya'는 'didn't want anyone to see' 바로 뒤 강조 삽입.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 바르게 배열하시오.

그녀의 가슴은 조여들었고, 손은 떨리고 있었다.
[tight / chest / her / felt / trembling / were / hands / and / her]
questions.ans: Her chest felt tight, and her hands were trembling.

det.korean: Her chest felt tight, and her hands were trembling.
det.analysis: felt + 형용사(tight). were + V-ing(trembling). and로 두 절 연결.
det.tip: felt tight = 감각동사 + 형용사 보어. were trembling = 과거진행형.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 바르게 배열하시오.

차가운 물에 발을 딛는 생각이 그녀의 속을 뒤틀리게 만들었다.
[cold / made / water / the thought / stomach / her / twist / of stepping into]
questions.ans: The thought of stepping into cold water made her stomach twist.

det.korean: The thought of stepping into cold water made her stomach twist.
det.analysis: make + O + 동사원형(원형부정사). the thought of + V-ing = 명사구 주어.
det.tip: make + 목적어 + 동사원형. to 없음 주의.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 바르게 배열하시오.

두려움이 그녀를 얼어붙게 한 것처럼 갇힌 느낌이었다.
[had / like / trapped / frozen / the fear / she / her / felt]
questions.ans: She felt trapped, like the fear had frozen her.

det.korean: She felt trapped, like the fear had frozen her.
det.analysis: felt + 분사(trapped). like + S + 과거완료(had frozen).
det.tip: felt trapped = 감각동사 + 분사. had frozen = 과거완료.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.

① She was wearing her regular clothes.
② Something about it filled her with dread.
③ Her heart beat more fastly.
④ She felt trapped.

det.korean: 평상복을 입고 있었다. 두려움으로 채워졌다. 심장이 더 [빠르게] 뛰었다. 갇힌 느낌이었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① wearing: 과거진행형 — 적절
✅ ② filled: 과거시제 — 적절
❌ ③ more fastly: fastly 없음. faster가 맞음
✅ ④ trapped: felt + 분사 — 적절
det.tip: fast의 부사형은 fast. 비교급 = faster.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.

① She looked at the adults standing on the dock.
② She hoped someone would say it was okay.
③ The thought of stepping into cold water made her stomach to twist.
④ She felt like crying.

det.korean: 부두에 서 있는 어른들을 바라봤다. 괜찮다고 말해주길 바랐다. 속을 [뒤틀리게] 했다. 울 것 같았다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① standing: 후치 현재분사 — 적절
✅ ② would say: hoped + 목적절 — 적절
❌ ③ to twist: 사역동사 make + 목적어 + 동사원형. to 없음
✅ ④ like crying: felt like + V-ing — 적절
det.tip: make + O + 동사원형. to twist(×) → twist(○).

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.

① Her hands were trembling.
② She didn't want no one to see.
③ Everyone was looking at her now.
④ She wanted to run away.

det.korean: 손은 떨리고 있었다. 아무도 [보지] 않길 바랐다. 모두가 그녀를 보고 있었다. 도망치고 싶었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① trembling: 과거진행형 — 적절
❌ ② no one: 이중부정(didn't + no one). anyone이 맞음
✅ ③ looking: 과거진행형 — 적절
✅ ④ to run: want to + 동사원형 — 적절
det.tip: didn't want anyone(○). didn't want no one(×) — 이중부정.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.

① She looked at the adults standing on the dock, hoping someone would say it.
② Her heart beat faster.
③ She felt like crying.
④ Like the fear has frozen her.

det.korean: 누군가 말해주길 바라며 어른들을 바라봤다. 심장이 더 빠르게 뛰었다. 울 것 같았다. 두려움이 [얼어붙게 한 것처럼].
det.analysis:
✅ ① hoping: 분사구문 — 적절
✅ ② beat: 불규칙 과거형 — 적절
✅ ③ like crying: felt like + V-ing — 적절
❌ ④ has frozen: 과거 맥락 → had frozen(과거완료)이 맞음
det.tip: 과거 서사에서 앞선 시제 = 과거완료. has frozen(×) → had frozen(○).

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

Something about it filled her with _____, even if she couldn't explain it.

det.korean: 무언가가 그녀를 _____으로 채웠다, 비록 설명할 수 없었지만.
det.analysis:
❌ ① joy: 기쁨 — 반대
✅ ② dread: 두려움 — 지문 원문
❌ ③ pride: 자부심
❌ ④ relief: 안도
det.tip: couldn't explain it = 원인 모를 공포. dread.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

She wanted to run away, but she felt _____, like the fear had frozen her.

det.korean: 도망치고 싶었지만 _____ 느낌이었다, 두려움이 얼어붙게 한 것처럼.
det.analysis:
❌ ① free: 자유로운 — 모순
❌ ② brave: 용감한 — 공포와 반대
✅ ③ trapped: 갇힌 — 도망치고 싶지만 못 함
❌ ④ excited: 흥분된
det.tip: run away + can't = trapped. frozen과 호응.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

Everyone was looking at her now, and it made her feel even _____.

det.korean: 모두가 그녀를 보고 있었고, 더 _____ 느끼게 만들었다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① better: 공포 반대
❌ ② calmer: 침착한
✅ ③ worse: 지문 원문 'feel even worse'
❌ ④ prouder: 자랑스러운
det.tip: 시선 집중 → 더 나쁜 감정(worse).

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

The thought of _____ into cold water with all her clothes on made her stomach twist.

det.korean: 모든 옷을 입은 채 차가운 물에 _____ 생각이 속을 뒤틀리게 했다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① jump: of + 동사원형 불가
❌ ② jumped: 과거형 불가
✅ ③ stepping: the thought of + V-ing 형태
❌ ④ stepped: 과거형 불가
det.tip: the thought of + V-ing(동명사). stepping이 맞음.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 알맞은 영어 단어를 쓰시오.

Her bathing suit was still in her _____, so she was wearing her regular clothes.

det.korean: 수영복이 아직 _____ 안에 있었다.
det.analysis: 지문 원문: 'her bathing suit was still in her bag'
det.tip: bag = 가방.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 알맞은 영어 단어를 쓰시오.

She looked at the adults standing on the _____, hoping someone would tell her it was okay.

det.korean: _____ 위에 서 있는 어른들을 바라봤다.
det.analysis: 지문: 'adults standing on the dock'
det.tip: dock = 부두.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 알맞은 영어 단어를 쓰시오.

She felt _____, like the fear had frozen her.

det.korean: 두려움이 얼어붙게 한 것처럼 _____ 느낌이었다.
det.analysis: 지문: 'she felt trapped, like the fear had frozen her'
det.tip: trapped = 갇힌.

questions.stem: Ryanna의 손 상태를 나타내는 **영어** 표현(2단어)을 지문에서 찾아 쓰시오.

det.korean: Ryanna의 손 상태 = were trembling(떨리고 있었다)
det.analysis: 지문: 'her hands were trembling'
det.tip: were trembling = 과거진행형. 공포에 떨리는 손.

questions.stem: Ryanna가 차가운 물에 뛰어드는 것을 생각했을 때 신체에 나타난 반응을 나타내는 **영어** 표현(2단어)을 지문에서 찾아 쓰시오.

det.korean: 차가운 물 생각 → 신체 반응 = stomach twist(속이 뒤틀리다)
det.analysis: 지문: 'made her stomach twist'
det.tip: stomach twist = 속이 뒤틀리다. 공포/불안의 신체 반응.
